units.zh: 志第十六 五行四
units.en: Treatise Sixteen: The Five Elements, Part Four.
units.literal: Treatise Sixteen: The Five Elements, Part Four.

units.zh: 地震 山崩 地陷 大风拔树 螟 牛疫
units.en: This section records earthquakes, landslides, sinkholes, gales that tear up forests, rice-borer infestations, and murrain among cattle.
units.literal: Earthquakes; mountains collapsing; ground subsiding; great winds uprooting trees; stem-borer pests; cattle plague.

units.zh: 《五行传》曰「治宫室，饰台榭，内淫乱，犯亲戚，侮父兄，则稼穑不成。」
units.en: The "Treatise on the Five Elements" says: "When one builds palace halls, adorns terraces and pavilions, carries on debauchery within, offends kinsmen, and insults fathers and elder brothers, then sowing and reaping do not succeed."
units.literal: The "Treatise on the Five Elements" says: "When one builds palace halls, adorns terraces and pavilions, carries on debauchery within, offends kinsmen, and insults fathers and elder brothers, then sowing and reaping do not succeed."

units.zh: 谓土失其性而为灾也。
units.en: That is, the element of soil is corrupted and disaster follows.
units.literal: —meaning earth loses its proper nature and becomes calamity.

units.zh: 又曰：「思心不容，是谓不圣。
units.en: The same text adds that when deliberation is cramped and counsel shut out, the ruler fails the standard of "sagacity.
units.literal: It also says: "When reflective thought finds no room, that is called lack of sagacity.

units.zh: 厥咎□，厥罚恒风，厥极凶短折。
units.en: The fault is muddled judgment; the matching scourge is ceaseless wind; the bitter end is untimely death in violence.
units.literal: Its blame [lacuna in text], its scourge is constant wind, its utmost end is violent early death.

units.zh: 时则有脂夜之妖，时则有华孽，时则有牛祸，时则有心腹之疴，时则有黄眚、黄祥，惟金、水、木、火□土。」
units.en: Such ages bring uncanny night lights, freak blossoms, cattle plagues, diseases of the vitals, and yellow hauntings—while metal, water, wood, and fire encroach on earth."
units.literal: In such seasons there are "fat-of-night" prodigies, flower freaks, cattle calamities, ailments of heart and belly, yellow spectral visitations and yellow auspices—only metal, water, wood, and fire [lacuna] earth."

units.zh: 华孽，刘歆传为蠃虫之孽，谓螟属也。
units.en: Liu Xin grouped these floral prodigies with "soft-bodied" vermin omens—in practice, the rice stem borer.
units.literal: Flower freaks"—Liu Xin's tradition classes them with omens among naked soft creatures, meaning the stem-borer kind.

units.zh: 世祖建武二十二年九月，郡国四十二地震，南阳尤甚，地裂压杀人。
units.en: Jianwu 22 (46 CE), ninth month: forty-two jurisdictions shook; Nanyang worst, with fissures that swallowed lives.
units.literal: In the ninth month of the twenty-second year of Jianwu, Emperor Guangwu, forty-two commanderies and kingdoms suffered earthquakes; Nanyang was especially severe—the earth split open and crushed people to death.

units.zh: 其后武谿蛮夷反，为寇害，至南郡，发荆州诸郡兵，遣武威将军刘尚击之，为夷所围，复发兵赴之，尚遂为所没。
units.en: Then the Wuxi tribes rose, raided south to Nanjun, and trapped Liu Shang's relief army—he and his men were wiped out.
units.literal: Afterward the Wuxi Man and Yi rebelled, becoming bandit scourges as far as Nanjun; troops from the several commanderies of Jingzhou were mobilized, and General of Martial Might Liu Shang was sent to strike them; he was surrounded by the tribes, troops were sent again to relieve him, and Shang was then lost with his force.

units.zh: 章帝建初元年三月甲寅，山阳、东平地震。
units.en: Jianchu 1 (76 CE), third month, jiayin: tremors struck Shanyang and Dongping.
units.literal: In the third month on the day jiayin of the first year of Jianchu, Emperor Zhang, Shanyang and Dongping suffered earthquakes.

units.zh: 和帝永元四年六月丙辰，郡国十三地震。
units.en: Yongyuan 4 (92 CE), sixth month, bingchen: thirteen provinces quaked.
units.literal: On the day bingchen in the sixth month of the fourth year of Yongyuan, Emperor He, thirteen commanderies and kingdoms suffered earthquakes.

units.zh: 《春秋汉含孳》曰：「女主盛，臣制命，则地动坼，畔震起，山崩沦。」
units.en: The "Spring and Autumn Han hanzi" says: "When the female ruler flourishes and ministers dictate the mandate, then the earth moves and splits, revolt and quake arise, mountains collapse and sink."
units.literal: The "Spring and Autumn Han hanzi" says: "When the female ruler flourishes and ministers dictate the mandate, then the earth moves and splits, revolt and quake arise, mountains collapse and sink."

units.zh: 是时，窦太后摄政，兄窦宪专权，将以是受祸也。
units.en: The Dou regency and Xian's monopoly on power were the moral fault behind the shock.
units.literal: At that time Empress Dowager Dou held the government; her elder brother Dou Xian monopolized power—they were about to receive calamity from this.

units.zh: 后五日，诏收宪印绶，兄弟就国，逼迫皆自杀。
units.en: Five days after: Xian's credentials were stripped; the brothers were sent to their domains and forced to kill themselves.
units.literal: Five days later an edict ordered Xian's seals and ribbons seized; the brothers went to their fiefs and were driven to suicide.

units.zh: 五年二月戊午，陇西地震。
units.en: Yongyuan 5, second month, wuwu: Longxi shook.
units.literal: On the day wuwu in the second month of the fifth year Longxi suffered an earthquake.

units.zh: 懦说民安土者也，将大动，行大震。
units.en: Commentators read the omen as meaning that the folk, whose life is bound to the soil, foretell a major convulsion when the ground itself is about to shift.
units.literal: The exegetical gloss says: "The people are those who find peace in the earth; when there is to be great movement, there will be a great earthquake."

units.zh: 九月，匈奴单于於除鞬叛，遣使发边郡兵讨之。
units.en: Ninth month: Shanyu Yuchujian turned rebel; border garrisons marched against him.
units.literal: In the ninth month the Xiongnu Shanyu Yuchujian rebelled; an envoy was sent to mobilize frontier commandery troops to punish him.

units.zh: 七年九月癸卯，京都地震。
units.en: Yongyuan 7 (95 CE), ninth month, guimao: Luoyang trembled.
units.literal: On the day guimao in the ninth month of the seventh year the capital suffered an earthquake.

units.zh: 儒说奄官无阳施，犹妇人也。
units.en: Scholars compared eunuchs to women: without "yang" generative force, they were a yin presence at court.
units.literal: The Ru view says palace attendants have no yang bestowal—they are like women.

units.zh: 是时和帝与中常侍郑众谋夺窦氏权，德之，因任用之，及幸常侍蔡伦，二人始并用权。
units.en: He had conspired with Zheng Zhong to break the Dous, then raised Zhong and Cai Lun until both eunuchs shared the inner court's power.
units.literal: At that time Emperor He with Regular Attendant Zheng Zhong plotted to seize the Dou clan's power; he valued Zhong and therefore employed him, and when he favored Regular Attendant Cai Lun, the two began together to wield power.

units.zh: 九年三月庚辰，陇西地震。
units.en: Yongyuan 9, third month, gengchen: another Longxi quake.
units.literal: On the day gengchen in the third month of the ninth year Longxi suffered an earthquake.

units.zh: 闰月，塞外羌犯塞，杀略吏民，使征西将军刘尚击之。
units.en: Intercalary month: frontier Qiang raided inward; Liu Shang was ordered west.
units.literal: In the intercalary month Qiang beyond the passes violated the frontier, killing and plundering officials and people; General Who Conquers the West Liu Shang was sent to strike them.

units.zh: 安帝永初元年，郡国十八地震。
units.en: Yongchu 1 (107 CE): eighteen jurisdictions reported tremors.
units.literal: In the first year of Yongchu, Emperor An, eighteen commanderies and kingdoms suffered earthquakes.

units.zh: 李固曰：「地者阴也，法当安静。
units.en: Li Gu said: "Earth is yin; by principle it ought to be still.
units.literal: Li Gu said: "Earth is yin; by principle it ought to be still.

units.zh: 今乃越阴之职，专阳之政，故应以震动。」
units.en: When yin usurps yang's role—women or ministers ruling in the emperor's stead—the ground answers with convulsions."
units.literal: Now it oversteps yin's office and monopolizes yang's government; therefore the response is to shake and move."

units.zh: 是时，邓太后摄政专事，讫建光中，太后崩，安帝乃得制政，于是阴类并胜，西羌乱夏，连十余年。
units.en: Through her death in Jianguang, the Deng regency blocked An from rule; yin forces ran wild, and the Qiang war dragged on for over a decade.
units.literal: At that time Empress Dowager Deng held the government and monopolized affairs; down to the Jianguang years the empress dowager died, and only then could Emperor An control government; then yin categories together prevailed, the Western Qiang threw Xia into turmoil, linked for more than ten years.

units.zh: 二年，郡国十二地震。
units.en: Yongchu 2: twelve provinces shook.
units.literal: The second year: twelve commanderies and kingdoms suffered earthquakes.

units.zh: 三年十二月辛酉，郡国九地震。
units.en: Yongchu 3, twelfth month, xinyou: nine jurisdictions quaked.
units.literal: On the day xinyou in the twelfth month of the third year nine commanderies and kingdoms suffered earthquakes.

units.zh: 四年三月癸巳，郡国四地震。
units.en: Yongchu 4, third month, guisi: four provinces felt the shock.
units.literal: On the day guisi in the third month of the fourth year four commanderies and kingdoms suffered earthquakes.

units.zh: 五年正月丙戌，郡国十地震。
units.en: Yongchu 5, first month, bingxu: ten commanderies shook.
units.literal: On the day bingxu in the first month of the fifth year ten commanderies and kingdoms suffered earthquakes.

units.zh: 七年正月壬寅，二月丙午，郡国十八地震。
units.en: Yongchu 7: tremors on renyin in the first month and bingwu in the second—eighteen jurisdictions in all.
units.literal: On the day renyin in the first month of the seventh year and on the day bingwu in the second month eighteen commanderies and kingdoms suffered earthquakes.

units.zh: 元初元年，郡国十五地震。
units.en: Yuanchu 1 (114 CE): fifteen provinces reported earthquakes.
units.literal: In the first year of Yuanchu fifteen commanderies and kingdoms suffered earthquakes.

units.zh: 二年十一月庚申，郡国十地震。
units.en: Yuanchu 2, eleventh month, gengshen: ten jurisdictions.
units.literal: On the day gengshen in the eleventh month of the second year ten commanderies and kingdoms suffered earthquakes.

units.zh: 三年二月，郡国十地震。
units.en: Yuanchu 3, second month: ten more.
units.literal: In the second month of the third year ten commanderies and kingdoms suffered earthquakes.

units.zh: 十一月癸卯，郡国九地震。
units.en: Yuanchu 3, eleventh month, guimao: nine commanderies.
units.literal: On the day guimao in the eleventh month nine commanderies and kingdoms suffered earthquakes.

units.zh: 四年，郡国十三地震。
units.en: Yuanchu 4: thirteen provinces shook.
units.literal: The fourth year: thirteen commanderies and kingdoms suffered earthquakes.

units.zh: 五年，郡国十四地震。
units.en: Yuanchu 5: fourteen jurisdictions.
units.literal: The fifth year: fourteen commanderies and kingdoms suffered earthquakes.

units.zh: 六年二月乙巳，京都、郡国四十二地震，或地坼裂，涌水，坏败城郭、民室屋，压杀人。
units.en: Yuanchu 6, second month, yisi: Luoyang and forty-two commanderies convulsed—fissures opened, springs burst through, walls and homes collapsed, and many were buried alive.
units.literal: On the day yisi in the second month of the sixth year the capital and forty-two commanderies and kingdoms suffered earthquakes; in places the earth split open, water gushed up, city walls and commoners' houses were ruined, and people were crushed to death.

units.zh: 冬，郡国八地震。
units.en: That winter eight more provinces trembled.
units.literal: In winter eight commanderies and kingdoms suffered earthquakes.

units.zh: 永宁元年，郡国二十三地震。
units.en: Yongning 1 (120 CE): twenty-three jurisdictions.
units.literal: In the first year of Yongning twenty-three commanderies and kingdoms suffered earthquakes.

units.zh: 建光元年九月己丑，郡国三十五地震，或地坼裂，坏城郭室屋，压杀人。
units.en: Jianguang 1 (121 CE), ninth month, jichou: thirty-five commanderies; ground split, towns ruined, lives lost.
units.literal: On the day jichou in the ninth month of the first year of Jianguang thirty-five commanderies and kingdoms suffered earthquakes; in places the earth split open, city walls and houses were ruined, and people were crushed to death.

units.zh: 是时，安帝不能明察，信宫人及阿母圣等谗言，破坏邓太后家，于是专听信圣及宦者，中常侍江京、樊丰等皆得用权。
units.en: An turned on the Dengs on whispered lies from Wang Sheng and the harem, then handed the realm to Jiang Jing, Fan Feng, and their fellow eunuchs.
units.literal: At that time Emperor An could not investigate clearly; he believed slander from palace women and his nurse Wang Sheng and the like, ruined Empress Dowager Deng's family, and thereafter listened exclusively to Sheng and the eunuchs—Regular Attendants Jiang Jing, Fan Feng, and others all came to wield power.

units.zh: 延光元年七月癸卯，京都、郡国十三地震。
units.en: Yanguang 1 (122 CE), seventh month, guimao: Luoyang and thirteen provinces shook.
units.literal: On the day guimao in the seventh month of the first year of Yanguang the capital and thirteen commanderies and kingdoms suffered earthquakes.

units.zh: 九月戊申，郡国二十七地震。
units.en: Ninth month, wushen: twenty-seven jurisdictions.
units.literal: On the day wushen in the ninth month twenty-seven commanderies and kingdoms suffered earthquakes.

units.zh: 二年，京都、郡国三十二地震。
units.en: Yanguang 2: the capital plus thirty-two commanderies quaked.
units.literal: The second year: the capital and thirty-two commanderies and kingdoms suffered earthquakes.

units.zh: 三年，京都、郡国二十三地震。
units.en: Yanguang 3: Luoyang and twenty-three provinces.
units.literal: The third year: the capital and twenty-three commanderies and kingdoms suffered earthquakes.

units.zh: 是时，以谗免太尉杨震，废太子。
units.en: That was the year Yang Zhen was ousted on false charges and the crown prince cast down.
units.literal: At that time, on slander Grand Commandant Yang Zhen was dismissed and the heir apparent deposed.

units.zh: 四年十一月丁巳，京都、郡国十六地震。
units.en: Yanguang 4, eleventh month, dingsi: the capital and sixteen commanderies.
units.literal: On the day dingsi in the eleventh month of the fourth year the capital and sixteen commanderies and kingdoms suffered earthquakes.

units.zh: 时安帝既崩，阎太后摄政，兄弟阎显等并用事，遂斥安帝子。
units.en: After An's death the Yan brothers, behind their sister's screen, set aside An's own boy from the succession.
units.literal: At that time Emperor An had already died; Empress Dowager Yan held the government; her brothers Yan Xian and company all managed affairs together, and they therefore cast aside Emperor An's son.

units.zh: 更征诸国王子，未至，中黄门遂诛显兄弟。
units.en: They called other princes toward the capital, but eunuchs struck first and slaughtered the Yans before the boys arrived.
units.literal: They summoned princes of the various kingdoms afresh; before they arrived, the Yellow Gates executed Xian and his brothers.

units.zh: 顺帝永建三年正月丙子，京都、汉阳地震。
units.en: Yongjian 3 (128 CE), first month, bingzi: Luoyang and Hanyang convulsed.
units.literal: On the day bingzi in the first month of the third year of Yongjian, Emperor Shun, the capital and Hanyang suffered earthquakes.

units.zh: 汉阳屋坏杀人，地坼涌水出。
units.en: Hanyang's buildings fell and crushed families; the soil gaped and water jetted from the cracks.
units.literal: In Hanyang houses collapsed and killed people; the earth split and gushing water came forth.

units.zh: 是时，顺帝阿母宋娥及中常侍张昉等用权。
units.en: Shun's wet nurse Song E and Zhang Fang were pulling the strings.
units.literal: At that time Emperor Shun's nurse Song E and Regular Attendant Zhang Fang and others employed power.

units.zh: 阳嘉二年四月己亥，京都地震，是时，爵号宋娥为山阳君。
units.en: Yangjia 2 (133 CE), fourth month, jihai: Luoyang shook the month Song E was ennobled as Lady of Shanyang.
units.literal: On the day jihai in the fourth month of the second year of Yangjia the capital suffered an earthquake; at that time the noble title of Song E was advanced to Lady of Shanyang.

units.zh: 四年十二月甲寅。
units.en: Yangjia 4, twelfth month, jiayin—a date heading the next entry.
units.literal: On the day jiayin in the twelfth month of the fourth year.

units.zh: 京都地震。
units.en: The capital trembled.
units.literal: The capital suffered an earthquake.

units.zh: 永和二年四月丙申，京都地震。
units.en: Yonghe 2 (137 CE), fourth month, bingshen: Luoyang quaked.
units.literal: On the day bingshen in the fourth month of the second year of Yonghe the capital suffered an earthquake.

units.zh: 是时宋娥构奸诬罔，五月事觉，收印绶，归田里。
units.en: Song's forged charges unraveled in the fifth month; she was stripped of rank and sent home.
units.literal: At that time Song E framed others with adultery and deceit; in the fifth month the affair was discovered, her seals and ribbons were seized, and she returned to the countryside.

units.zh: 十一月丁卯，京都地震。
units.en: Eleventh month, dingmao: another shock under Luoyang.
units.literal: On the day dingmao in the eleventh month the capital suffered an earthquake.

units.zh: 是时，太尉王龚以中常侍张昉等专弄国权，欲奏诛之，时龚宗亲有以杨震行事谏之止云。
units.en: Wang Gong wanted the eunuchs dead for usurping authority, but kin talked him down with the memory of Yang Zhen's fatal stand.
units.literal: At that time Grand Commandant Wang Gong, because Regular Attendants Zhang Fang and others monopolized and toyed with state power, wished to memorialize to execute them; at that time a kinsman of Gong's remonstrated using Yang Zhen's precedent and stopped at that.

units.zh: 三年二月乙亥，京都、金城、陇西地震裂，城郭、室屋多坏，压杀人。
units.en: Yonghe 3, second month, yihai: Luoyang, Jincheng, and Longxi split open; walls and roofs fell and killed many.
units.literal: On the day yihai in the second month of the third year the capital, Jincheng, and Longxi suffered earthquakes and splitting; many city walls and houses were ruined, and people were crushed to death.

units.zh: 闰月己酉，京都地震。
units.en: Intercalary month, jiyou: the capital shook again.
units.literal: On the day jiyou in the intercalary month the capital suffered an earthquake.

units.zh: 十月，西羌二千余骑入金城塞，为凉州害。
units.en: Tenth month: two thousand Qiang riders poured through Jincheng to ravage Liangzhou.
units.literal: In the tenth month more than two thousand Western Qiang horsemen entered the Jincheng frontier pass, doing harm to Liangzhou.

units.zh: 四年三月乙亥，京都地震。
units.en: Yonghe 4, third month, yihai: Luoyang trembled.
units.literal: On the day yihai in the third month of the fourth year the capital suffered an earthquake.

units.zh: 五年二月戍申，京都地震。
units.en: Yonghe 5, second month, wushen: Luoyang shook again.
units.literal: On the day wushen in the second month of the fifth year the capital suffered an earthquake.

units.zh: 建康元年正月，凉州部郡六地震。
units.en: Jiankang 1 (144 CE), first month: six Liangzhou commanderies shook.
units.literal: In the first month of the first year of Jiankang six commanderies in the Liangzhou division suffered earthquakes.

units.zh: 从去年九月以来至四月，凡百八十地震，山谷坼裂，坏败城寺，伤害人、物。
units.en: In seven months one hundred eighty shocks cracked the northwest—gorges split, monasteries and towns crumbled.
units.literal: From the ninth month of the previous year down to the fourth month there were in all one hundred eighty earthquakes; valleys and mountains split open, city monasteries were ruined, and people and goods were injured.

units.zh: 三月，护羌校尉赵冲为叛胡所杀。
units.en: Third month: Zhao Chong died at the hands of rebel tribesmen.
units.literal: In the third month Colonel Who Protects the Qiang Zhao Chong was killed by mutinous Hu.

units.zh: 九月丙午，京都地震。
units.en: Ninth month, bingwu: Luoyang quaked.
units.literal: On the day bingwu in the ninth month the capital suffered an earthquake.

units.zh: 是时，顺帝崩，梁太后摄政，欲为顺帝作陵，制度奢广，多坏吏民冢。
units.en: The Liang dowager was leveling tombs wholesale to build Shun a grand tomb.
units.literal: At that time Emperor Shun had died; Empress Dowager Liang held the government; she wished to build a mausoleum for Emperor Shun on a lavish scale, destroying many officials' and commoners' tombs.

units.zh: 尚书栾巴谏事，太后怒。
units.en: Luan Ba protested; she flew into a rage.
units.literal: Secretary Luan Ba remonstrated about the affair; the empress dowager was angry.

units.zh: 癸卯，诏书收巴下狱，欲杀之。
units.en: On guimao she had him jailed to be executed.
units.literal: On guimao an edict ordered Ba seized and imprisoned, intending to kill him.

units.zh: 丙午，地震，于是太后乃出巴，免为庶人。
units.en: When the earth shook on bingwu she freed him and reduced him to commoner status.
units.literal: On bingwu there was an earthquake; thereupon the empress dowager released Ba and dismissed him as a commoner.

units.zh: 桓帝建和元年四月庚寅，京都地震。
units.en: Jianhe 1 (147 CE), fourth month, gengyin: Luoyang trembled.
units.literal: On the day gengyin in the fourth month of the first year of Jianhe, Emperor Huan, the capital suffered an earthquake.

units.zh: 九月丁卯，京都地震。
units.en: Ninth month, dingmao: another shock.
units.literal: On the day dingmao in the ninth month the capital suffered an earthquake.

units.zh: 是时，梁太后摄政，兄冀持权。
units.en: Liang Ji dominated the court behind his sister's regency.
units.literal: At that time Empress Dowager Liang held the government; her elder brother Ji grasped power.

units.zh: 至和平元年，太后崩，然冀犹秉政专事，至延熹二年，乃诛灭。
units.en: She died in Heping 1, but Ji clung to power until Yanxi 2, when he and his clan were destroyed.
units.literal: Down to the first year of Heping the empress dowager died, yet Ji still monopolized government and affairs; down to the second year of Yanxi he was then executed and extinguished.

units.zh: 三年九月己卯，地震，庚寅又震。
units.en: Jianhe 3, ninth month: the earth shook on jimao and again on gengyin.
units.literal: On the day jimao in the ninth month of the third year there was an earthquake; on gengyin there was again a quake.

units.zh: 元嘉元年十一月辛巳，京都地震。
units.en: Yuanjia 1 (151 CE), eleventh month, xinsi: Luoyang shook.
units.literal: On the day xinsi in the eleventh month of the first year of Yuanjia the capital suffered an earthquake.

units.zh: 二年正月丙辰，京都地震。
units.en: Yuanjia 2, first month, bingchen: another.
units.literal: On the day bingchen in the first month of the second year the capital suffered an earthquake.

units.zh: 十月乙亥，京都地震。
units.en: Tenth month, yihai: the capital quaked.
units.literal: On the day yihai in the tenth month the capital suffered an earthquake.

units.zh: 永兴二年二月癸卯，京都地震。
units.en: Yongxing 2 (154 CE), second month, guimao: Luoyang trembled.
units.literal: On the day guimao in the second month of the second year of Yongxing the capital suffered an earthquake.

units.zh: 永寿二年十二月，京都地震。
units.en: Yongshou 2 (156 CE), twelfth month: capital shock.
units.literal: In the twelfth month of the second year of Yongshou the capital suffered an earthquake.

units.zh: 延熹四年，京都、右扶风、凉州地震。
units.en: Yanxi 4 (161 CE): tremors from Luoyang west to Youfufeng and Liangzhou.
units.literal: In the fourth year of Yanxi the capital, Youfufeng, and Liangzhou suffered earthquakes.

units.zh: 五年五月乙亥，京都地震。
units.en: Yanxi 5, fifth month, yihai: the capital.
units.literal: On the day yihai in the fifth month of the fifth year the capital suffered an earthquake.

units.zh: 是时，桓帝与中常侍单超等谋诛除梁冀，听之，并使用事专权。
units.en: Huan and Shan Chao had just brought down Liang Ji; the eunuchs now ran everything.
units.literal: At that time Emperor Huan with Regular Attendant Shan Chao and others plotted to execute and remove Liang Ji; he listened to them, and they together wielded power and monopolized affairs.

units.zh: 又邓皇后本小人，性行无恒，苟有颜色，立以为后，后卒坐执左道废，以忧死。
units.en: Empress Deng had been elevated for her face alone; she ended on charges of witchcraft, stripped of rank, and broken-hearted.
units.literal: Moreover Empress Deng was originally a petty person; her nature and conduct had no constancy; merely because she had looks she was set up as empress—afterward she finally sat condemned for "left-way" sorcery, was deposed, and died of grief.

units.zh: 八年九月丁未，京都地震。
units.en: Yanxi 8, ninth month, dingwei: Luoyang shook.
units.literal: On the day dingwei in the ninth month of the eighth year the capital suffered an earthquake.

units.zh: 灵帝建宁四年二月癸卯，地震。
units.en: Jianning 4 (171 CE), second month, guimao: tremor.
units.literal: On the day guimao in the second month of the fourth year of Jianning, Emperor Ling, there was an earthquake.

units.zh: 是时，中常侍曹节、王甫等皆专权。
units.en: Cao Jie, Wang Fu, and their circle held the levers of state.
units.literal: At that time Regular Attendants Cao Jie, Wang Fu, and others all monopolized power.

units.zh: 熹平二年六月，地震。
units.en: Xiping 2 (173 CE), sixth month: earthquake.
units.literal: In the sixth month of the second year of Xiping there was an earthquake.

units.zh: 六年十月辛丑，地震。
units.en: Xiping 6, tenth month, xinchou: tremor.
units.literal: On the day xinchou in the tenth month of the sixth year there was an earthquake.

units.zh: 光和元年二月辛未，地震。
units.en: Guanghe 1 (178 CE), second month, xinwei: quake.
units.literal: On the day xinwei in the second month of the first year of Guanghe there was an earthquake.

units.zh: 四月丙辰，地震。
units.en: Fourth month, bingchen: another shock.
units.literal: On the day bingchen in the fourth month there was an earthquake.

units.zh: 灵帝时宦者专恣。
units.en: Under Ling the palace attendants did as they pleased.
units.literal: In Emperor Ling's time eunuchs acted wantonly and without restraint.

units.zh: 二年三月，京兆地震。
units.en: Guanghe 2, third month: Jingzhao trembled.
units.literal: In the third month of the second year Jingzhao suffered an earthquake.

units.zh: 三年自秋至明年春，酒泉表氏地八十余动，涌水出，城中官寺民舍皆顿。
units.en: Guanghe 3–4: Bishi in Jiuquan shook over eighty times from autumn to spring; springs burst through the streets and every structure slumped.
units.literal: From autumn of the third year through the next spring in Jiuquan Bishi the ground moved more than eighty times, gushing water came forth, and official buildings and private houses in the city all collapsed.

units.zh: 县易处，更筑城郭。
units.en: The county seat was moved and new walls raised.
units.literal: The county shifted its site and rebuilt city walls.

units.zh: 献帝初平二年六月丙戌，地震。
units.en: Chuping 2 (191 CE), sixth month, bingxu: the ground shook.
units.literal: On the day bingxu in the sixth month of the second year of Chuping, Emperor Xian, there was an earthquake.

units.zh: 兴平元年六月丁丑，地震。
units.en: Xingping 1 (194 CE), sixth month, dingchou: the ground shook.
units.literal: On the day dingchou in the sixth month of the first year of Xingping there was an earthquake.

units.zh: 和帝永元元年七月，会稽南山崩。
units.en: Yongyuan 1 (89 CE), seventh month: a peak south of Kuaiji gave way.
units.literal: In the seventh month of the first year of Yongyuan, Emperor He, the southern mountain of Kuaiji collapsed.

units.zh: 会稽，南方大名山也。
units.en: The Kuaiji range was one of the great southern massifs.
units.literal: Kuaiji is a great famous mountain of the south.

units.zh: 京房《易传》曰：「山崩，阴乘阳，弱胜强也。」
units.en: Jing Fang's "Tradition of the Changes" says: "When mountains collapse, yin rides atop yang; the weak conquers the strong."
units.literal: Jing Fang's "Tradition of the Changes" says: "When mountains collapse, yin rides atop yang; the weak conquers the strong."

units.zh: 刘向以为山阳，君也；
units.en: Liu Xiang read the mountain as the sovereign, the yang aspect of the land.
units.literal: Liu Xiang held that mountains mean the yang of mountains—the ruler.

units.zh: 水阴，民也；
units.en: Water stood for yin, the common folk.
units.literal: Water is yin; the common people.

units.zh: 君道崩坏，百姓失所也。
units.en: When the ruler's course breaks, the people lose their homes.
units.literal: The ruler's way collapses and ruins; the hundred surnames lose their place.

units.zh: 刘歆以为崩犹弛也。
units.en: Liu Xin compared a mountain fall to foundations giving way.
units.literal: Liu Xin held that "collapse" is like "slackening."

units.zh: 是时，窦太后摄政，兄窦宪专权。
units.en: Again the Dou regency: the dowager and Xian held the Han court in their hands.
units.literal: At that time Empress Dowager Dou held the government; her elder brother Dou Xian monopolized power.

units.zh: 七年七月，赵国易阳地裂。
units.en: Seventh month, seventh year: the soil cracked at Yiyang in Zhao.
units.literal: In the seventh month of the seventh year the earth of Yiyang in Zhao commandery split open.

units.zh: 京房《易传》曰：「地裂者，臣下分离，不肯相从也。」
units.en: Jing Fang's "Tradition of the Changes" says: "When the ground splits, ministers and subordinates separate and refuse to follow one another."
units.literal: Jing Fang's "Tradition of the Changes" says: "When the ground splits, ministers and subordinates separate and refuse to follow one another."

units.zh: 是时，南单于众乖离，汉军追讨。
units.en: The Southern Xiongnu host had fractured; imperial troops were in pursuit.
units.literal: At that time the Southern Shanyu's followers were rebellious and split away; Han armies pursued and punished them.

units.zh: 十二年夏，闰四月戊辰，南郡秭归山高四百丈崩，填溪，杀百余人。
units.en: Yongyuan 12 (100 CE), intercalary fourth month, wuchen: a four-hundred-zhang cliff at Zigui sheared off, blocked a gorge, and buried over a hundred souls.
units.literal: In the summer of the twelfth year, intercalary fourth month, on the day wuchen, a mountain four hundred zhang high in Zigui, Nan commandery, collapsed, dammed a stream, and killed more than a hundred people.

units.zh: 明年冬，巫蛮夷反，遣使募荆州吏民万余人击之。
units.en: Next winter the Wushan tribes rose; the court drafted ten thousand Jingzhou men to fight them.
units.literal: The next winter the Wu Man and Yi rebelled; an envoy was sent to recruit more than ten thousand clerks and people of Jingzhou to strike them.

units.zh: 元兴元年五月癸酉，右扶风雍地裂。
units.en: Yuanxing 1 (105 CE), fifth month, guiyou: the ground split at Yong in right Fufeng.
units.literal: On the day guiyou in the fifth month of the first year of Yuanxing the earth of Yong in Youfufeng split open.

units.zh: 是後西羌大寇涼州。
units.en: Then the Western Qiang poured into Liangzhou.
units.literal: Afterward the Western Qiang raided Liangzhou on a great scale.

units.zh: 殇帝延平元年五月壬辰，河东垣山崩。
units.en: Yanping 1 (106 CE), fifth month, renchen: Mount Yuan in Hedong fell.
units.literal: On the day renchen in the fifth month of the first year of Yanping, Emperor Shang, Mount Yuan in Hedong collapsed.

units.zh: 是时，邓太后专政。
units.en: The Deng regency still ruled.
units.literal: At that time Empress Dowager Deng monopolized government.

units.zh: 秋八月，殇帝崩。
units.en: That autumn, eighth month, the infant emperor died.
units.literal: In the eighth month of autumn Emperor Shang died.

units.zh: 安帝永初元年六月丁巳，河东杨地陷。
units.en: Yongchu 1, sixth month, dingsi: a sinkhole opened at Yang in Hedong.
units.literal: On the day dingsi in the sixth month of the first year of Yongchu, Emperor An, the ground subsided at Yang in Hedong.

units.zh: 东西百四十步，南北百二十步，深三丈五尺。
units.en: It measured 140 by 120 paces and sank nearly forty feet.
units.literal: One hundred forty paces east–west, one hundred twenty paces north–south, three zhang five chi deep.

units.zh: 六年六月壬辰，豫章员谿原山崩，各六十三所。
units.en: Yongchu 6, sixth month, renchen: sixty-three slides scarred the Yuanxi highlands in Yuzhang.
units.literal: On the day renchen in the sixth month of the sixth year the Yuanxi plateau in Yuzhang saw mountains collapse—sixty-three places in all.

units.zh: 元初元年三月己卯，日南地坼，长百八十二里。
units.en: Yuanchu 1 (114 CE), third month, jimao: a rift 182 li long tore Rinan commandery.
units.literal: On the day jimao in the third month of the first year of Yuanchu Rinan's earth split open one hundred eighty-two li.

units.zh: 其后三年正月，苍梧、郁林、合浦盗贼群起，劫略吏民。
units.en: Three years on, coastal Guangxi erupted in banditry.
units.literal: Three years later, in the first month, bandits rose in swarms in Cangwu, Yulin, and Hepu, plundering officials and people.

units.zh: 二年六月，河南雒阳新城地裂。
units.en: Yuanchu 2, sixth month: another fissure at Luoyang's Xincheng district.
units.literal: In the sixth month of the second year the earth split at Xincheng in Henan, Luoyang.

units.zh: 延光二年七月，丹阳山崩四十七所。
units.en: Yanguang 2 (123 CE), seventh month: forty-seven landslides in Danyang.
units.literal: In the seventh month of the second year of Yanguang forty-seven places in Danyang saw mountains collapse.

units.zh: 三年六月庚午，巴郡阆中山崩。
units.en: Yanguang 3, sixth month, gengwu: Mount Langzhong in Ba gave way.
units.literal: On the day gengwu in the sixth month of the third year Mount Langzhong in Ba commandery collapsed.

units.zh: 四年十月丙午，蜀郡越巂山崩，杀四百余人。
units.en: Yanguang 4, tenth month, bingwu: a Yuexi peak in Shu buried four hundred souls.
units.literal: On the day bingwu in the tenth month of the fourth year Mount Yuexi in Shu commandery collapsed, killing more than four hundred people.

units.zh: 丙午，天子会日也。
units.en: The almanac marks bingwu as an imperial audience day—doubly ominous.
units.literal: Bingwu is a day when the Son of Heaven holds court.

units.zh: 是时，阎太后摄政。
units.en: The Yan empress dowager was regent.
units.literal: At that time Empress Dowager Yan held the government.

units.zh: 其十一月，中黄门孙程等杀江京，立顺帝，诛阎后兄弟，明年，阎后崩。
units.en: Eleventh month: eunuchs led by Sun Cheng murdered Jiang Jing, raised Shun, and wiped out the Yans; the dowager followed her kin to the grave the next year.
units.literal: That eleventh month the Yellow Gates Sun Cheng and others killed Jiang Jing and enthroned Emperor Shun; they executed Empress Yan's brothers; the next year the empress dowager Yan died.

units.zh: 顺帝阳嘉二年六月丁丑，雒阳宣德亭地坼，长八十五丈，近郊地。
units.en: Yangjia 2 (133 CE), sixth month, dingchou: an eighty-five-zhang crack opened at the Xuande pavilion by the southern suburb.
units.literal: On the day dingchou in the sixth month of the second year of Yangjia the Xuande lodge ground at Luoyang split open, eighty-five zhang long, near the suburban altar.

units.zh: 时，李固时策，以为「阴类专恣，将有分离之象，所以附郊城者，是上帝示象以诫陛下也。」
units.en: At that time Li Gu offered a policy memorial, holding that "yin categories act wantonly and there will be signs of separation; that it attaches to the suburban wall means High Heaven is displaying an image to warn Your Majesty."
units.literal: At that time Li Gu offered a policy memorial, holding that "yin categories act wantonly and there will be signs of separation; that it attaches to the suburban wall means High Heaven is displaying an image to warn Your Majesty."

units.zh: 是时宋娥及中常侍各用权分争，后中常侍张逵、蘧政与大将军梁商争权，为商作飞语，欲陷之。
units.en: Song E and the eunuchs feuded; Zhang Kui and Qu Zheng then tried to frame Liang Shang with whisper campaigns.
units.literal: At that time Song E and the regular attendants each employed power and quarreled in factions; afterward Regular Attendants Zhang Kui and Qu Zheng contended for power with Grand General Liang Shang; they spread flying rumors about Shang, intending to entrap him.

units.zh: 桓帝建和元年四月，郡国六地裂，水涌出，井溢，坏寺屋，杀人。
units.en: Jianhe 1 (147 CE), fourth month: six jurisdictions split open—springs burst, wells boiled over, buildings fell, and lives were lost.
units.literal: In the fourth month of the first year of Jianhe, Emperor Huan, six commanderies saw the earth split; water gushed forth, wells overflowed, monasteries and houses were ruined, and people were killed.

units.zh: 时，梁太后摄政，兄冀枉杀李固、杜乔。
units.en: Liang Ji, behind his sister's regency, had murdered Li Gu and Du Qiao.
units.literal: At that time Empress Dowager Liang held the government; her elder brother Ji unjustly killed Li Gu and Du Qiao.

units.zh: 三年，郡国五山崩。
units.en: Jianhe 3: five provinces reported landslides.
units.literal: In the third year five commanderies and kingdoms saw mountains collapse.

units.zh: 和平元年七月，广汉梓潼山崩。
units.en: Heping 1 (150 CE), seventh month: Zitong mountain in Guanghan fell.
units.literal: In the seventh month of the first year of Heping Mount Zitong in Guanghan collapsed.

units.zh: 永兴二年六月，东海朐山崩。
units.en: Yongxing 2 (154 CE), sixth month: Mount Qu in Donghai gave way.
units.literal: In the sixth month of the second year of Yongxing Mount Qu in Donghai collapsed.

units.zh: 冬十二月，泰山、琅邪盗贼群起。
units.en: That winter brigandage flared across Taishan and Langye.
units.literal: In the twelfth month of winter bandits rose in swarms in Mount Tai and Langye.

units.zh: 永寿三年七月，河东地裂。
units.en: Yongshou 3 (157 CE), seventh month: Hedong fissured.
units.literal: In the seventh month of the third year of Yongshou Hedong's earth split open.

units.zh: 时，梁皇后兄冀秉政，桓帝欲自由，内患之。
units.en: Liang Ji still choked the court while Huan schemed to shake free.
units.literal: At that time Empress Liang's elder brother Ji held power; Emperor Huan wished to be free and inwardly worried over him.

units.zh: 延熹元年七月乙巳，左冯翊云阳地裂。
units.en: Yanxi 1 (158 CE), seventh month, yisi: Yunyang in left Fengyi cracked.
units.literal: On the day yisi in the seventh month of the first year of Yanxi the earth split open at Yunyang in Left Fengyi.

units.zh: 三年五月甲戌，汉中山崩。
units.en: Yanxi 3, fifth month, jiaxu: Mount Han in the Hanzhong march collapsed.
units.literal: On the day jiaxu in the fifth month of the third year Mount Han collapsed.

units.zh: 是时上宠恣中常侍单超等。
units.en: Huan was showering favor on Shan Chao and his fellow eunuchs.
units.literal: At that time the emperor indulged and spoiled Regular Attendants Shan Chao and the like.

units.zh: 四年六月庚子，泰山、博尤来山判解。
units.en: Yanxi 4, sixth month, gengzi: Tai Mountain and the Youlai ridge near Bo town sundered.
units.literal: On the day gengzi in the sixth month of the fourth year Mount Tai and Mount Youlai in Bo split apart.

units.zh: 八年六月丙辰，缑氏地裂。
units.en: Yanxi 8, sixth month, bingchen: the soil gaped at Goushi.
units.literal: On the day bingchen in the sixth month of the eighth year the earth split open at Goushi.

units.zh: 永康元年五月丙午，雒阳高平永寿亭、上党泫氏地各裂。
units.en: Yongkang 1 (167 CE), fifth month, bingwu: twin fissures—one at the Yongshou pavilion in Luoyang, one at Xuanshi in Shangdang.
units.literal: On the day bingwu in the fifth month of the first year of Yongkang the ground split at Gaoping Yongshou lodge in Luoyang and at Xuanshi in Shangdang—each place.

units.zh: 是时，朝臣患中常侍王甫等专恣。
units.en: Ministers fretted over Wang Fu's unchecked eunuch faction.
units.literal: At that time court officials worried that Regular Attendant Wang Fu and others acted wantonly.

units.zh: 冬，桓帝崩。
units.en: That winter Huan died.
units.literal: In winter Emperor Huan died.

units.zh: 明年，窦氏等欲诛常侍、黄山，不果，更为所诛。
units.en: Next year Dou Wu's coup against the regular attendants failed; the plotters were slaughtered instead. Manuscripts disagree on a single word in the source line, but every version describes the same reversal.
units.literal: The next year Dou Wu and the others wished to execute the regular attendants and the Yellow Gates but did not succeed; they were instead executed by them.

units.zh: 灵帝建宁四年五月，河东地裂十二处，裂合长十里百七十步，广者三十余步，深不见底。
units.en: Jianning 4, fifth month: Hedong opened twelve parallel chasms—over eleven li end to end, thirty paces across at the widest, depth lost in shadow.
units.literal: In the fifth month of the fourth year of Jianning, Emperor Ling, Hedong's earth split in twelve places; the cracks joined to a length of ten li one hundred seventy paces, the widest more than thirty paces deep, bottom not visible.

units.zh: 和帝永元五年五月戊寅，南阳大风，拔树木。
units.en: Yongyuan 5 (93 CE), fifth month, wuyin: a gale tore up Nanyang's forests.
units.literal: On the day wuyin in the fifth month of the fifth year of Yongyuan, Emperor He, Nanyang had a great wind that uprooted trees.

units.zh: 安帝永初元年，大风拔树。
units.en: Yongchu 1: gales ripped trees from the earth.
units.literal: In the first year of Yongchu, Emperor An, a great wind uprooted trees.

units.zh: 是时，邓太后摄政，以清河王子年少，号精耳，故立之，是为安帝。
units.en: The Deng dowager enthroned the young Qinghe prince, praising his precocity; he became Emperor An.
units.literal: At that time Empress Dowager Deng held the government; because the prince of Qinghe was young—in reputation still a clever child—therefore he was set up; this was Emperor An.

units.zh: 不立皇太子胜，以为安帝贤，必当德邓氏也；
units.en: She bypassed Prince Sheng, betting that An would reward the Dengs for the throne.
units.literal: She did not enthrone Imperial Son Sheng, holding that Emperor An was worthy and would surely repay the Deng clan with gratitude.

units.zh: 后安帝亲谗，废免邓氏，令郡县迫切，死者八九人，家至破坏。
units.en: An later swallowed lies about the Dengs, purged them savagely, and left eight or nine dead—whole houses destroyed.
units.literal: Afterward Emperor An personally believed slander, deposed and dismissed the Deng clan, and ordered the commanderies and counties to press them urgently—eight or nine died, families down to ruin.

units.zh: 此为瞉霿也。
units.en: That was the arrogant obscuration the omen text names as the blame.
units.literal: This was arrogant obscuration.

units.zh: 是后西羌亦大乱凉州十有余年。
units.en: Then the Qiang war convulsed Liangzhou for another decade.
units.literal: Afterward the Western Qiang also threw Liangzhou into great chaos for more than ten years.

units.zh: 二年六月，京都及郡国四十大风拔树。
units.en: Yongchu 2, sixth month: forty jurisdictions lost trees to wind.
units.literal: In the sixth month of the second year the capital and forty commanderies and kingdoms had great winds that uprooted trees.

units.zh: 三年五月癸酉，京都大风，拔南郊道梓树九十六枚。
units.en: Yongchu 3, fifth month, guiyou: a wind sheared ninety-six catalpas from the processional avenue to the southern altar.
units.literal: On the day guiyou in the fifth month of the third year the capital had a great wind that uprooted ninety-six catalpa trees along the southern suburban road.

units.zh: 七年八月丙寅，京都大风拔树。
units.en: Yongchu 7, eighth month, bingyin: Luoyang gales again.
units.literal: On the day bingyin in the eighth month of the seventh year the capital had a great wind that uprooted trees.

units.zh: 元初二年二月癸亥，京都大风拔树。
units.en: Yuanchu 2, second month, guihai: capital windthrow.
units.literal: On the day guihai in the second month of the second year of Yuanchu the capital had a great wind that uprooted trees.

units.zh: 六年夏四月，沛国、勃海大风，拔树三万余枚。
units.en: Yuanchu 6, fourth month of summer: Pei and Bohai counted thirty thousand trees down.
units.literal: In the fourth month of summer of the sixth year Pei and Bohai had a great wind that uprooted more than thirty thousand trees.

units.zh: 延光二年三月丙申，河东、颍川大风拔树。
units.en: Yanguang 2, third month, bingshen: Hedong and Yingchuan gales.
units.literal: On the day bingshen in the third month of the second year of Yanguang Hedong and Yingchuan had a great wind that uprooted trees.

units.zh: 六月壬午，郡国十一大风拔树。
units.en: Sixth month, renwu: eleven provinces in a single storm.
units.literal: On the day renwu in the sixth month eleven commanderies and kingdoms had great winds that uprooted trees.

units.zh: 是时，安帝亲谗，曲直不分。
units.en: An could no longer tell truth from slander.
units.literal: At that time Emperor An personally believed slander; straight and crooked were not distinguished.

units.zh: 三年，京都及郡国三十六大风拔树。
units.en: Yanguang 3: thirty-six jurisdictions plus the capital.
units.literal: In the third year the capital and thirty-six commanderies and kingdoms had great winds that uprooted trees.

units.zh: 灵帝建宁二年四月癸巳，京都大风雨雹，拔郊道树十围已上百余枚。
units.en: Jianning 2, fourth month, guisi: wind, rain, and hail snapped over a hundred massive trees lining the sacred way.
units.literal: On the day guisi in the fourth month of the second year of Jianning, Emperor Ling, the capital had great wind, rain, and hail that uprooted more than a hundred trees ten arm-spans and more along the suburban road.

units.zh: 其后晨迎气黄郊，道于雒水西桥，逢暴风雨，道卤簿车或发盖，百官沾濡，还，不至郊；
units.en: Later, at the yellow-suburb rite at dawn, a squall struck the Luo's west bridge—umbrella-chariots lost their hoods, ministers were soaked, and the cortège turned back without finishing the ceremony.
units.literal: Afterward at dawn they welcomed qi at the yellow suburban altar; the road lay on the west bridge of the Luo—there they met a violent rainstorm; some canopy carriages in the procession had their covers torn off; the hundred officials were drenched; they returned without reaching the suburb.

units.zh: 使有司行礼。
units.en: The court had ministers complete the ritual by proxy.
units.literal: They ordered the responsible officials to perform the rites.

units.zh: 迎气西郊，亦壹如此。
units.en: The western-suburb ceremony failed the same way.
units.literal: Welcoming qi at the western suburb was exactly the same.

units.zh: 中平五年六月丙寅，大风拔树。
units.en: Zhongping 5 (188 CE), sixth month, bingyin: another windthrow.
units.literal: On the day bingyin in the sixth month of the fifth year of Zhongping a great wind uprooted trees.

units.zh: 獻帝初平四年六月，右扶風大風，發屋拔木。
units.en: Chuping 4 (193 CE), sixth month: west of the capital, gales stripped roofs and timber.
units.literal: In the sixth month of the fourth year of Chuping, Emperor Xian, Youfufeng had a great wind that tore off roofs and uprooted trees.

units.zh: 中兴以来，脂夜之妖无录者。
units.en: After Guangwu restored the Han, the annals list no more "midnight grease" omens.
units.literal: Since the restoration none of the "fat-of-night" prodigies have been recorded.

units.zh: 章帝七八年间，郡县大螟伤稼，语在《鲁恭传》，而纪不录也。
units.en: Zhang's mid-reign saw caterpillar plagues—Lu Gong's memoir treats them, though the basic annals omit the entry.
units.literal: In the seventh and eighth years of Emperor Zhang commanderies and counties had great stem-borers injuring the crops—the account is in the biography of Lu Gong, but the annals do not record it.

units.zh: 是时，章帝用窦皇后谗，害宋、梁二贵人，废皇太子。
units.en: Zhang believed Dou's lies, destroyed the Song and Liang ladies, and cast down the crown prince.
units.literal: At that time Emperor Zhang listened to Empress Dou's slander, harmed Worthy Ladies Song and Liang, and deposed the heir apparent.

units.zh: 灵帝熹平四年六月，弘农，三辅螟虫为害。
units.en: Xiping 4 (175 CE), sixth month: borers devoured the capital region's grain.
units.literal: In the sixth month of the fourth year of Xiping, Emperor Ling, Hongnong and the three adjuncts suffered stem-borer pests.

units.zh: 是时，灵帝用中常侍曹节等谗言，禁锢海内清英之士，谓之党人。
units.en: Ling let Cao Jie brand the honest scholars as "partisans" and hunt them down.
units.literal: At that time Emperor Ling listened to Regular Attendant Cao Jie and others' slander, proscribed the pure and outstanding men of the realm within, calling them "factionists."

units.zh: 中平二年七月，三辅螟虫为害。
units.en: Zhongping 2 (185 CE), seventh month: the borers returned to the capital districts.
units.literal: In the seventh month of the second year of Zhongping the three adjuncts suffered stem-borer pests.

units.zh: 明帝永平十八年，牛疫死。
units.en: Yongping 18 (75 CE): murrain wiped out the herds.
units.literal: In the eighteenth year of Yongping, Emperor Ming, cattle died in plague.

units.zh: 是岁，遣窦固等征西域，置都护、戊己校尉。
units.en: The same year Dou Gu marched west and the court posted a protector-general and Wuji colonels.
units.literal: That year Dou Gu and others were dispatched to campaign in the Western Regions; a protector-general and the Wuji garrison colonels were established.

units.zh: 固等适还而西域叛，杀都护陈睦、戊己校尉关宠。
units.en: No sooner had the army withdrawn than the west rebelled—Chen Mu and Guan Chong fell.
units.literal: When Gu and the others had just returned the Western Regions rebelled, killing Protector-General Chen Mu and Wuji Colonel Guan Chong.

units.zh: 于是大怒，欲复发兴讨，会秋明帝崩，是思心不容也。
units.en: Ming meant to strike again but died that autumn—Heaven cutting short a ruler who would not listen.
units.literal: Thereupon the court was greatly angered and wished to launch another great punitive expedition; it happened that in autumn Emperor Ming died—this is "reflective thought finding no room."

units.zh: 章帝建初四年冬，京都牛大疫。
units.en: Jianchu 4 (79 CE), winter: cattle plague struck the capital herds.
units.literal: In the winter of the fourth year of Jianchu, Emperor Zhang, the capital's cattle suffered a great plague.

units.zh: 是时，窦皇后以宋贵人子为太子，宠幸，令人求伺贵人过隙，以谗毁之。
units.en: Empress Dou's son sat as heir; she set agents to sniff out Lady Song's slips and ruin her with lies.
units.literal: At that time Empress Dou had the son of Worthy Lady Song as heir apparent, favored and beloved; she ordered people to seek out the worthy lady's faults and destroy her with slander.

units.zh: 章帝不知窦太后不善，厥咎霿也。
units.en: Zhang never saw Dou's malice—the fault named obscuration in the omen text.
units.literal: Emperor Zhang did not realize Empress Dowager Dou was not good—the blame was obscuration.

units.zh: 或曰，是年六月马太后崩，土功非时兴故也。
units.en: Another gloss ties the plague to Ma's death that sixth month and the untimely earthworks her tomb demanded.
units.literal: Another view says that in that year in the sixth month Empress Dowager Ma died, and earthworks were raised out of season for that reason.

units.zh: 竇武字游平，扶風平陵人，安豐戴侯融之玄孫也。
units.en: Dou Wu, styled Youping, came from Pingling in Fufeng; he was a fourth-generation descendant of Dou Rong, Marquis Dai of Anfeng.
units.literal: Dou Wu, courtesy name Youping, was a native of Pingling in Fufeng, and was the great-great-grandson of the Marquis Dai of Anfeng, Dou Rong.

units.zh: 其冬，貴人立為皇后，武遷越騎校尉，封槐里侯，五千戶。
units.en: That same winter she became empress; Dou Wu rose to colonel of the swift cavalry and received the title Marquis of Huaili with a fief of five thousand households.
units.literal: That winter the honored lady was established as empress; Wu was promoted colonel of the agile cavalry, enfeoffed marquis of Huaili with five thousand households.

units.zh: 書奏，因以病上還城門校尉、槐里侯印綬。
units.en: After submitting it, he cited illness and tendered the seals of his posts as colonel of the city gates and Marquis of Huaili.
units.literal: When the memorial was presented, on account of illness he submitted and returned the seals of colonel of the city gates and marquis of Huaili.

units.zh: 帝既立，論定策功，更封武為聞喜侯；
units.en: Once the new emperor was enthroned, those who had settled the succession were rewarded, and Dou Wu received a further enfeoffment as Marquis of Wenxi;
units.literal: When the emperor had been established, they assessed merit in settling the succession, and Wu was further enfeoffed marquis of Wenxi;

units.zh: 延熹八年，長女選入掖庭，桓帝以為貴人，拜武郎中。
units.en: In 165 CE his eldest daughter was chosen for the imperial harem; Emperor Huan elevated her to honored consort and named Dou Wu a gentleman attendant at court.
units.literal: In the eighth year of Yanxi, his eldest daughter was selected and entered the Rear Palace; Emperor Huan made her an honored lady and appointed Wu gentleman of the palace.

units.zh: 明年冬，拜城門校尉。
units.en: The following winter he was named colonel of the city gates.
units.literal: The next winter he was appointed colonel of the city gates.

units.zh: 拜武為大將軍，常居禁中。
units.en: Dou Wu was named grand general and took up permanent residence inside the palace.
units.literal: Wu was appointed grand general and constantly resided within the forbidden precincts.

units.zh: 武既輔朝政，常有誅翦宦官之意，太傅陳蕃亦素有謀。
units.en: As chief minister Dou Wu meant to purge the eunuchs, and Grand Tutor Chen Fan had long nursed the same design.
units.literal: When Wu had assisted court government, he constantly had the intention to execute and extirpate the eunuchs; the grand tutor Chen Fan also long had plans.

units.zh: 武少以經行著稱，常教授於大澤中，不交時事，名顯關西。
units.en: From his youth Dou Wu was known for scholarship and upright conduct; he taught students amid the wetlands, kept clear of politics, and his reputation spread through the Guanxi region.
units.literal: In youth Wu was renowned for his classical learning and conduct; he often taught in great marshlands, did not involve himself in current affairs, and his name was illustrious west of the passes.

units.zh: 父奉，定襄太守。
units.en: His father Dou Feng had served as governor of Dingxiang.
units.literal: His father was Dou Feng, governor of Dingxiang.

units.zh: 兄子紹，為虎賁中郎將，性疏簡奢侈。
units.en: His nephew Dou Shao commanded the palace tiger guard; he was careless by temperament and lived lavishly.
units.literal: His elder brother's son Shao was a leader of the palace tiger guard, by nature careless and lax, and extravagant.

units.zh: 子機渭陽侯，拜侍中；
units.en: his son Dou Ji became Marquis of Weiyang and a palace attendant;
units.literal: his son Ji was marquis of Weiyang, appointed palace attendant;

units.zh: 在位多辟名士，清身疾惡，禮賂不通，妻子衣食裁充足而已。
units.en: In office he recruited eminent scholars, kept himself scrupulously clean and detested corruption, refused illicit gifts, and saw to it that his family had only what they needed.
units.literal: In office he often summoned famous scholars, purified himself and hated evil, did not communicate through ritual bribes, and his wife and children had clothing and food only just sufficient.

units.zh: 永康元年，上疏諫曰：「臣聞明主不諱譏刺之言，以探幽暗之實；
units.en: In 167 CE Dou Wu presented a memorial of remonstrance: "I have heard that a wise ruler does not shrink from pointed criticism, so as to learn what is hidden in the dark;
units.literal: In the first year of Yongkang, he submitted a memorial remonstrating, saying: "I have heard that a bright ruler does not shun words of reproof and satire, in order to probe the truth of what is hidden and dark;

units.zh: 武入白太后，遂徵立之，是為靈帝。
units.en: Dou Wu laid the matter before the empress dowager; Liu Hong was summoned and enthroned as Emperor Ling.
units.literal: Wu entered and reported to the empress dowager; then (Hong) was summoned and established; this was Emperor Ling.

units.zh: 忠臣不卹諫爭之患，以暢萬端之事。
units.en: and that a loyal minister does not fear the harm that comes from remonstrance, so that every matter may be fully aired.
units.literal: a loyal minister does not spare himself the peril of remonstrance and dispute, in order to set forth fully the myriad affairs of state.

units.zh: 是以君臣並熙，名奮百世。
units.en: Thus ruler and minister prosper together, and their fame endures for generations.
units.literal: Hence ruler and minister together flourish, and their fame blazes for a hundred generations.

units.zh: 臣幸得遭盛明之世，逢文武之化，豈敢懷祿逃罪，不竭其誠！
units.en: I have been blessed to live in a glorious age and to meet the civilizing influence of Wen and Wu—how could I cling to office, evade blame, and withhold my utmost loyalty!
units.literal: I have been fortunate to encounter an age of great brilliance and to meet the civilizing influence of Wen and Wu—how would I dare cling to salary and flee from blame, and not exhaust my sincerity!

units.zh: 陛下初從藩國，爰登聖祚，天下逸豫，謂當中興。
units.en: Your Majesty rose from a princely domain to the throne; the realm rejoiced and looked for a renewal of Han.
units.literal: Your Majesty at first came from a feudal state and then ascended the sacred throne; the realm was at ease and delighted, and all believed there would be restoration.

units.zh: 自即位以來，未聞善政。
units.en: Yet since your accession I have heard of no worthy policy.
units.literal: Since taking the throne, I have not heard of good government.

units.zh: 梁、孫、寇、鄧雖或誅滅，而常侍黃門續為禍虐，欺罔陛下，競行譎詐，自造制度，妄爵非人，朝政日衰，姦臣日彊。
units.en: Liang Ji, Sun Shou, Kou Rong, and Deng Wan may have been destroyed, but the eunuchs still bring ruin: they deceive Your Majesty, vie in deceit, invent their own rules, ennoble unworthy men, and day by day court government rots while wicked ministers grow stronger.
units.literal: Liang, Sun, Kou, and Deng were perhaps executed and destroyed, yet the regular palace attendants and yellow-gate officials continue as agents of calamity and cruelty, deceiving Your Majesty, competing in treachery and fraud, inventing regulations on their own, enfeoffing unworthy men, so that court government daily declines and wicked ministers daily grow strong.

units.zh: 伏尋西京放恣王氏，佞臣執政，終喪天下。
units.en: I reflect on how the Wang clan ran wild in the Western Capital, how sycophants seized power, and how the dynasty was lost.
units.literal: I bow and recall how in the Western Capital the Wang clan was indulged without restraint, flatterers held government, and in the end the realm was lost.

units.zh: 今不慮前事之失，復循覆車之軌，臣恐二世之難，必將復及，趙高之變，不朝則夕。
units.en: Now, heedless of past failures, the court again follows the road of the overturned cart; I fear a Second Emperor catastrophe will return, and a Zhao Gao-style coup may come overnight.
units.literal: Now, without considering the errors of former affairs, you again follow the track of an overturned cart; I fear the calamity of the Second Emperor will surely come again, and a change like Zhao Gao's may arrive not in the morning but by evening.

units.zh: 近者姦臣牢脩，造設黨議，遂收前司隸校尉李膺、太僕杜密、御史中丞陳翔、太尉掾范滂等逮考，連及數百人，曠年拘錄，事無效驗。
units.en: Recently the villain Lao Xiu invented the partisan prosecutions; Li Ying, Du Mi, Chen Xiang, Fan Pang, and hundreds more were seized and held for years without a shred of proof.
units.literal: Recently the wicked minister Lao Xiu fabricated the partisan prosecution; then the former metropolitan commandant Li Ying, grand coachman Du Mi, imperial censor Chen Xiang, and grand commandant aide Fan Pang and others were seized and examined, implicating several hundred men; for years they have been detained and recorded, yet the affair has yielded no proof.

units.zh: 臣惟膺等建忠抗節，志經王室，此誠陛下稷、党、伊、呂之佐，而虛為姦臣賊子之所誣枉，天下寒心，海內失望。
units.en: Li Ying and his fellows have shown loyal resolve and devotion to the royal house—they are truly ministers in the mold of Ji, Xie, Yi, and Lü—yet wicked men have falsely accused them; the realm is heartsick and the empire has lost hope.
units.literal: I consider that Ying and the others established loyalty and upheld integrity, their will fixed on sustaining the royal house; they are truly Your Majesty's helpers like Ji, Xie, Yi, and Lü, yet they have been falsely slandered by wicked ministers and villainous sons; the realm is chilled at heart, and within the seas all are disappointed.

units.zh: 惟陛下留神澄省，時見理出，以厭人鬼喁喁之心。
units.en: I beg Your Majesty to attend carefully, judge clearly, and release the innocent in time, so that the murmuring hearts of men and spirits may be stilled.
units.literal: May Your Majesty keep your mind attentive, clarify and examine, and in due time bring forth justice, so as to satisfy the murmuring hearts of men and ghosts alike.

units.zh: 臣聞古之明君，必須賢佐，以成政道。
units.en: I have heard that wise rulers of old always needed worthy aides to govern well.
units.literal: I have heard that the bright rulers of antiquity necessarily required worthy assistants to complete the way of government.

units.zh: 今臺閣近臣，尚書令陳蕃，僕射胡廣，尚書朱宇、荀緄、劉祐、魏朗、劉矩、尹勳等，皆國之貞士，朝之良佐。
units.en: Among the ministers at court today—Director Chen Fan, Vice Director Hu Guang, and the secretaries Zhu Yu, Xun Gun, Liu You, Wei Lang, Liu Ju, and Yin Xun—are upright servants of the state and able aides of the court.
units.literal: Now among the close ministers of the Secretariat, Director Chen Fan, Vice Director Hu Guang, and Ministers Zhu Yu, Xun Gun, Liu You, Wei Lang, Liu Ju, Yin Xun, and others are all upright men of the state and fine assistants of the court.

units.zh: 尚書郎張陵、媯皓、苑康、楊喬、邊韶、戴恢等，文質彬彬，明達國典。
units.en: Secretariat gentlemen such as Zhang Ling, Gui Hao, Yuan Kang, Yang Qiao, Bian Shao, and Dai Hui combine learning and integrity and know the laws of the realm.
units.literal: Secretariat gentlemen Zhang Ling, Gui Hao, Yuan Kang, Yang Qiao, Bian Shao, Dai Hui, and others are refined in both literary and substantive virtue and clearly understand the statutes of the state.

units.zh: 內外之職，群才並列。
units.en: Within the palace and without, talented men stand ready in every office.
units.literal: Within and without, offices are filled with many talents arrayed together.

units.zh: 而陛下委任近習，專樹饕餮，外典州郡，內幹心膂。
units.en: Yet Your Majesty entrusts power to cronies and raises greedy parasites who rule the provinces abroad and meddle in the vital organs of government at court.
units.literal: Yet Your Majesty entrusts power to close favorites, exclusively raising gluttonous beasts: abroad they govern provinces and commanderies, within they meddle in the heart and sinews of state.

units.zh: 宜以次貶黜，案罪糾罰，抑奪宦官欺國之封，案其無狀誣罔之罪，信任忠良，平決臧否，使邪正毀譽，各得其所，寶愛天官，唯善是授。
units.en: They should be demoted in turn, their crimes prosecuted, the eunuchs' illicit fiefs stripped away, and their false accusations punished; trust the loyal, judge merit and fault fairly, let the wicked and upright each receive their due, and honor the offices of state by granting them only to the worthy.
units.literal: They ought to be demoted and dismissed in due order; crimes should be investigated and punished; the enfeoffments by which eunuchs deceive the state should be suppressed and seized; their baseless crimes of false accusation should be prosecuted; the loyal and good should be trusted; merit and fault should be judged fairly, so that the wicked and upright, whether praised or blamed, each receive what is due; treasure and honor the offices of Heaven, and grant them only to the worthy.

units.zh: 如此，咎徵可消，天應可待。
units.en: Then ominous signs may fade and Heaven's blessing may follow.
units.literal: If this is done, ominous signs may be dispelled and Heaven's favorable response may be awaited.

units.zh: 閒者有嘉禾、芝草、黃龍之見。
units.en: Recently there have been reports of auspicious grain, lingzhi fungus, and yellow dragons.
units.literal: Recently there have been sightings of auspicious grain, lingzhi fungus, and yellow dragons.

units.zh: 夫瑞生必於嘉士，福至實由善人，在德為瑞，無德為災。
units.en: Omens appear only where worthy men dwell; blessings truly come from the good—with virtue they are auspicious, without virtue they are calamity.
units.literal: Auspicious omens arise only where there are worthy men; blessings in truth come from good men—with virtue they are omens, without virtue they are disasters.

units.zh: 陛下所行，不合天意，不宜稱慶。」
units.en: Your Majesty's conduct does not accord with Heaven's will; there is no cause for celebration."
units.literal: What Your Majesty has done does not accord with Heaven's will; it is not fitting to proclaim celebration."

units.zh: 是時羌蠻寇難，歲儉民飢，武得兩宮賞賜，悉散與太學諸生，及載肴糧於路，飩施貧民。
units.en: With Qiang and southern tribes raiding and famine stalking the land, Dou Wu took every gift from the two palaces and gave it to the Imperial Academy students, and he had food carted along the roads to feed the destitute.
units.literal: At that time the Qiang and Man brought calamity, the year was lean and the people hungry; Wu obtained rewards from the two palaces, all scattered them to the students of the Imperial Academy, and moreover loaded viands and grain on the roads and fed the poor.

units.zh: 武每數切厲相戒，猶不覺悟，乃上書求退紹位，又自責不能訓導，當先受罪。
units.en: Dou Wu remonstrated with him sharply time and again, but the young man did not reform; Dou Wu then memorialized asking that Shao be dismissed and declared himself unfit as a mentor, offering to accept punishment first.
units.literal: Wu repeatedly sternly admonished him, yet he still did not awaken; then he submitted a memorial requesting to remove Shao from office, and moreover blamed himself for being unable to instruct and guide, saying he should first receive punishment.

units.zh: 武召侍御史河閒劉儵，參問其國中王子侯之賢者，儵稱解瀆亭侯宏。
units.en: Dou Wu called in the attendant censor Liu Shu of Hejian and asked which of the imperial clansmen there was fit to rule; Liu Shu recommended Liu Hong, Marquis of the Jiedu pavilion.
units.literal: Wu summoned attendant censor Liu Shu of Hejian, consulted him on worthy princes and marquises in that state, and Shu praised Marquis Hong of the Jiedu pavilion.

units.zh: 武深然之。
units.en: Dou Wu agreed wholeheartedly.
units.literal: Wu deeply approved this.

units.zh: 時共會朝堂，蕃私謂武曰：「中常侍曹節、王甫等，自先帝時操弄國權，濁亂海內，百姓匈匈，歸咎於此。
units.en: When they met at court, Chen Fan took Dou Wu aside and said, "Cao Jie, Wang Fu, and their fellow eunuchs have twisted the levers of power since the previous reign; the empire is in turmoil and the people lay every ill at their door.
units.literal: At the time they jointly met in the court hall; Fan privately said to Wu: "The palace attendants Cao Jie, Wang Fu, and others, since the former emperor's time have grasped and played with state power, defiled and thrown into disorder the realm within the seas; the hundred surnames are in an uproar and ascribe blame to this.

units.zh: 今不誅節等，後必難圖。」
units.en: If we do not cut them down now, we will never manage it later."
units.literal: If now we do not execute Jie and the others, later it will certainly be difficult to plan."

units.zh: 武於是引同志尹勳為尚書令，劉瑜為侍中，馮述為屯騎校尉；
units.en: Dou Wu then appointed allies to key posts: Yin Xun as director of the secretariat, Liu Yu as palace attendant, and Feng Shu as colonel of garrison cavalry;
units.literal: Thereupon Wu brought in like-minded Yin Xun as director of the secretariat, Liu Yu as palace attendant, Feng Shu as colonel of garrison cavalry;

units.zh: 又徵天下名士廢黜者前司隸李膺、宗正劉猛、太僕杜密、廬江太守朱宇等，列於朝廷；
units.en: he recalled celebrated men who had been cashiered—among them the former metropolitan commandant Li Ying, the director of the imperial clan Liu Meng, the grand coachman Du Mi, and the governor of Lujiang Zhu Yu—and seated them again at court;
units.literal: and further summoned to the court famous scholars of the realm who had been dismissed: former metropolitan commandant Li Ying, director of the imperial clan Liu Meng, grand coachman Du Mi, governor of Lujiang Zhu Yu, and others, arraying them at court;

units.zh: 請前越巂太守荀翌為從事中郎，辟潁川陳寔為屬：共定計策。
units.en: he named the former governor of Yuegui, Xun Yi, as staff supervisor and recruited Chen Shi of Yingchuan as an aide, and with them he hammered out a strategy.
units.literal: requested the former governor of Yuegui Xun Yi as staff supervisor, summoned Chen Shi of Yingchuan as subordinate: together they settled plans and strategy.

units.zh: 於是天下雄俊，知其風旨，莫不延頸企踵，思奮其智力。
units.en: Word of their purpose spread, and bold men across the empire strained to join them, eager to lend mind and muscle to the cause.
units.literal: Thereupon the heroes and outstanding men of the realm, knowing their intent, none did not crane their necks and stand on tiptoe, thinking to exert their intelligence and strength.

units.zh: 常欲訪山東而尋子雲，問關西而求伯起，遇有今信，力附相聞，遲比來郵，慰其延佇。」
units.en: I had long wished to search Shandong for Zhong Jun and inquire west of the Pass for Yang Zhen. Now that a messenger has arrived, I have urgently entrusted him with this word. I await the next courier to ease my long suspense."
units.literal: I had long wished to search Shandong for Ziyun and inquire west of the Pass for Boqi. Now that a messenger has arrived, I have urgently entrusted him with this word. I await the next courier to console my protracted waiting."

units.zh: 建初八年，代鄭眾為大司農。
units.en: In Jianchu 8 he succeeded Zheng Zhong as Minister of Agriculture.
units.literal: In the eighth year of Jianchu, replaced Zheng Zhong as Minister of Agriculture.

units.zh: 是時中常侍鄭眾，蔡倫等皆秉勢豫政，章數進直言。
units.en: Palace attendants Zheng Zhong, Cai Lun, and others then held power in government; Zhou Zhang repeatedly offered blunt counsel.
units.literal: At this time the palace attendants Zheng Zhong, Cai Lun, and others all held power and took part in government; Zhang repeatedly advanced blunt counsel.

units.zh: 章以眾心不附，遂密謀閉宮門，誅車騎將軍鄧騭兄弟及鄭眾、蔡倫，劫尚書，廢太后於南宮，封帝為遠國王，而立平原王勝。
units.en: Zhou Zhang, finding popular hearts unattached, secretly plotted to shut the palace gates, execute Deng Zhi and his brothers along with Zheng Zhong and Cai Lun, seize the Masters of Writing, depose the empress dowager in the Southern Palace, banish the emperor to a distant kingdom, and enthrone Prince Sheng of Pingyuan.
units.literal: Zhang, because popular hearts did not attach, then secretly plotted to shut the palace gates, execute Chariots-and-Cavalry General Deng Zhi and his brothers along with Zheng Zhong and Cai Lun, seize the Masters of Writing, depose the empress dowager in the Southern Palace, enfeoff the emperor as king of a distant state, and enthrone King of Pingyuan Sheng.

units.zh: 永元中，和帝追尊其母梁贵人曰恭怀皇后，陵曰西陵。
units.en: In Yongyuan, Hedi posthumously raised his mother, Lady Liang, to Empress Gonghuai; her tomb was Xiling.
units.literal: In the Yongyuan era Emperor He posthumously honored his mother, the Lady of Liang, as Empress Gonghuai, and her tomb was called Xiling.

units.zh: 以窦后配食章帝，恭怀后别就陵寝祭之。
units.en: Empress Dou shared Zhangdi’s cult, but Empress Gonghuai was worshipped separately at her tomb lodge.
units.literal: Empress Dou was paired to share Zhangdi’s offering, while Empress Gonghuai was separately worshipped at her mausoleum lodge.

units.zh: 初，安帝永初三年，太白入鬥，洛陽大水。
units.en: Earlier, in Yongchu 3 under Emperor An, Venus entered the Northern Dipper as Luoyang was inundated.
units.literal: Earlier, in the third year of Yongchu of Emperor An, Great White entered the Dipper and Luoyang suffered great flooding.

units.zh: 宣馳入以白帝，帝大怒，遂與中常侍單超、具瑗、唐衡、左悺、徐璜等五人成謀誅冀。
units.en: Lady Xuan reached Emperor Huan; he allied with the five eunuchs to destroy Liang Ji.
units.literal: Xuan galloped to report to the emperor; the emperor was greatly angered and with palace attendants Shan Chao, Ju Yuan, Tang Heng, Zuo Guan, and Xu Huang plotted Ji's execution.

units.zh: 冀心疑超等，乃使中黃門張惲入省宿，以防其變。
units.en: Ji posted Zhang Yun inside the palace as a precaution.
units.literal: Ji suspected Chao and the others; therefore sent palace attendant Zhang Yun into the palace quarters overnight to guard against a coup.

units.zh: 鄧太後詔公卿以下會議，恭議奏曰：
units.en: Empress Dowager Deng summoned the high ministers to debate the matter; Gong submitted his opinion:
units.literal: Empress Dowager Deng ordered dukes and ministers downward to assemble in conference; Gong debated and memorialized, saying:

units.zh: 順帝既立，石與喜皆以阿黨閻顯、江京等策免，復為衛尉。
units.en: When Emperor Shun took the throne, Feng Shi and Liu Xi were cashiered for colluding with Yan Xian and Jiang Jing; Feng Shi later returned as minister of the guards.
units.literal: When Emperor Shun was already established, Shi and Xi both because of currying faction with Yan Xian, Jiang Jing and others were removed by edict; again became minister of the guards.

units.zh: 孝章皇帝深惟古人之道，助三正之微，定律著令，冀承天心，順物性命，以致時雍。
units.en: Emperor Zhang pondered antiquity, harmonized the three beginnings in law, and hoped to align Heaven with the nature of things for universal peace.
units.literal: Emperor Zhang deeply pondered the Way of ancients, assisting the subtlety of the three beginnings; fixing statutes and establishing orders; hoping to inherit Heaven's heart, comply with creatures' natures and lives, so as to bring seasonal harmony.

units.zh: 肅宗集諸儒於白虎觀，恭特以經明得召，與其議。
units.en: When Emperor Zhang convened scholars at White Tiger Hall, Gong was invited on strength of his classical expertise and joined the debates.
units.literal: Emperor Suzong assembled the Confucians at White Tiger Hall; Gong was specially summoned because of his clarity on the classics and participated in their discussions.

units.zh: 初，肅宗時，斷獄皆以冬至之前，自後論者互多駁異。
units.en: Under Emperor Zhang capital cases had to conclude before the winter solstice; later scholars quarreled endlessly over the rule.
units.literal: Formerly, in Emperor Suzong's time, cutting prison cases was all before the winter solstice; afterward debaters mutually increased refutations and differences.

units.zh: 建初元年，肅宗詔舉賢良方正，大司農劉寬舉丕。
units.en: In Jianchu 1 Emperor Zhang sought worthy candidates; Minister of Agriculture Liu Kuan nominated Lu Pi.
units.literal: In the first year of Jianchu, Emperor Suzong ordered recommendation of worthy and upright men; Minister of Agriculture Liu Kuan recommended Pi.

units.zh: 其後帝巡狩之趙，特被引見，難問經傳，厚加賞賜。
units.en: Later, when the emperor toured Zhao, Pi was specially summoned, examined on the classics, and richly rewarded.
units.literal: Afterward, when the emperor toured Zhao, Pi was specially summoned for audience, questioned on the classics, and richly rewarded.

units.zh: 魯恭字仲康，扶風平陵人也。
units.en: Lu Gong, styled Zhongkang, was a native of Pingling in Fufeng.
units.literal: Lu Gong, courtesy name Zhongkang, was a man of Pingling in Fufeng.

units.zh: 建初初，丕舉方正，恭始為郡吏。
units.en: Early in the Jianchu era Pi earned recommendation as 'upright and honest,' after which Gong accepted a post as commandery clerk.
units.literal: At the beginning of Jianchu, Pi was recommended as upright and honest; Gong then became a commandery clerk.

units.zh: 永初元年，復代梁鮪為司徒。
units.en: In Yongchu 1 he again succeeded Liang Wei as Minister of Education.
units.literal: In the first year of Yongchu he again replaced Liang Wei as Minister of Education.

units.zh: 十五，與母及丕俱居太學，習《魯詩》，閉戶講誦，絕人間事，兄弟俱為諸儒所稱，學士爭歸之。
units.en: At fifteen he moved into the Imperial Academy with his mother and Pi to study the Lu Odes behind closed doors, ignoring the world; both brothers won praise from the faculty and students flocked to study under them.
units.literal: At fifteen he together with his mother and Pi all dwelt in the Imperial Academy, studying the Lu version of the Odes; they closed doors and lectured and recited, cutting off worldly affairs; both brothers were praised by the various Confucians; students contended to attach to them.

units.zh: 其後拜為《魯詩》博士，由是家法學者日盛。
units.en: He was later named Erudite of the Lu Odes, and disciples of his scholarly line multiplied.
units.literal: Later he was appointed Erudite in the Lu Odes; henceforth scholars of his household tradition daily flourished.

units.zh: 建武初，為武陵太守，卒官。
units.en: Early in Jianwu he became grand administrator of Wuling and died in that post.
units.literal: At the beginning of Jianwu he was grand administrator of Wuling and died in office.

units.zh: 時恭年十二，弟丕七歲，晝夜號踴不絕聲，郡中賻贈無所受，乃歸服喪，禮過成人，鄉裏奇之。
units.en: Gong was twelve and Pi seven when their father died; they keened without pause and refused the commandery's funeral contributions, then went home to mourn with rites beyond what boys their age were expected to observe—the neighbors were astonished.
units.literal: At that time Gong was twelve and his younger brother Pi seven; day and night they wailed and leaped without stopping their voices; they accepted none of the commandery's condolence gifts; then they returned to observe mourning; their ritual exceeded adults; the village marveled at them.

units.zh: 建初七年，郡國螟傷稼，犬牙緣界，不入中牟。
units.en: In Jianchu 7 crop-eating caterpillars ravaged neighboring jurisdictions along zigzag borders yet spared Zhongmou entirely.
units.literal: In the seventh year of Jianchu, caterpillars in the commanderies and kingdoms harmed the crops; along boundaries like dogs' teeth they did not enter Zhongmou.

units.zh: 河南尹袁安聞之，疑其不實，使仁恕掾肥親往廉之。
units.en: Henan's governor Yuan An doubted the reports and dispatched his investigator Fei Qin to verify them.
units.literal: Governor of Henan Yuan An heard of it and doubted its truth; he sent Assistant for Benevolence Fei Qin to go investigate it.

units.zh: 和帝初立，議遣車騎將軍竇憲與征西將軍耿秉擊匈奴，恭上疏諫曰：
units.en: Early in Emperor He's reign the court debated dispatching Dou Xian and Geng Bing against the Xiongnu; Gong filed a memorial of opposition:
units.literal: When Emperor He had first been established, they debated sending General of Chariots and Cavalry Dou Xian and General Who Conquers the West Geng Bing to strike the Xiongnu; Gong submitted a memorial remonstrating, saying:

units.zh: 永元九年，徵拜議郎。
units.en: In Yongyuan 9 he was summoned and appointed Consultant.
units.literal: In the ninth year of Yongyuan he was summoned and appointed Consultant.

units.zh: 八月，飲酎，齋會章臺，詔使小黃門特引恭前。
units.en: In the eighth month, during the libation feast and fasting assembly at Zhang Terrace, an edict had a junior palace attendant bring Gong forward.
units.literal: In the eighth month, at the libation feast with fasting assembly at Zhang Terrace, an edict ordered a junior palace attendant to bring Gong forward specially.

units.zh: 其夜拜侍中，敕使陪乘，勞問甚渥。
units.en: That night he was made Palace Attendant, ordered to ride in attendance, and received exceptionally warm praise.
units.literal: That night he was appointed Palace Attendant; he was ordered to ride in attendance; the gracious inquiry was very generous.

units.zh: 冬，遷光祿勛，選舉清平，京師貴戚莫能枉其正。
units.en: In winter he became Household Minister; his nominations were fair, and even capital nobles could not sway his judgment.
units.literal: In winter he was promoted to Household Minister; his selections were clear and fair; none of the capital's noble kin could bend his integrity.

units.zh: 十三年，代呂蓋為司徒。
units.en: In year thirteen he succeeded Lü Gai as Minister of Education.
units.literal: In the thirteenth year he replaced Lü Gai as Minister of Education.

units.zh: 十五年，從巡狩南陽，除子撫為郎中，賜駙馬從駕。
units.en: In year fifteen he accompanied the tour to Nanyang; his son Fu was made a palace gentleman and allowed to ride in the imperial escort.
units.literal: In the fifteenth year he followed the imperial tour to Nanyang; his son Fu was appointed Gentleman of the Palace and granted the privilege of riding in the imperial escort.

units.zh: 時弟丕亦為侍中。
units.en: At that time his younger brother Lu Pi was also Palace Attendant.
units.literal: At that time his younger brother Pi was also Palace Attendant.

units.zh: 殤帝即位，以恭為長樂衛尉。
units.en: When Emperor Shang succeeded, Gong was appointed Commandant of Changle.
units.literal: When Emperor Shang succeeded, Gong was made Commandant of Changle.

units.zh: 三年，以老病策罷。
units.en: In the third year age and illness forced his retirement by imperial order.
units.literal: In the third year, on account of old age and illness he was dismissed by edict.

units.zh: 六年，年八十一，卒於家。
units.en: He died at home in the sixth year at eighty-one.
units.literal: In the sixth year, aged eighty-one, he died at home.

units.zh: 恭憐丕小，欲先就其名，托疾不仕。
units.en: Because Pi was still young, Gong held back his own career so his brother might shine first, claiming illness to avoid appointment.
units.literal: Gong pitied Pi's youth and wished first to establish Pi's reputation; he pleaded illness and did not take office.

units.zh: 以兩子為郎。
units.en: The court appointed two of his sons as Gentlemen.
units.literal: Two sons were made Gentlemen.

units.zh: 長子謙，為隴西太守，有名績。
units.en: His eldest son Qian served as grand administrator of Longxi with a distinguished record.
units.literal: The eldest son Qian was grand administrator of Longxi and had famed accomplishments.

units.zh: 其先出於魯頃公，為楚所滅，遷於下邑，因氏焉。
units.en: The family traced its line to Duke Qing of Lu; after Chu conquered Lu they settled in Xia yi and adopted Lu as their clan name.
units.literal: His ancestors came from Duke Qing of Lu; when Lu was destroyed by Chu they moved to Xia yi and took their surname there.

units.zh: 太尉趙憙慕其誌，每歲時遣子問以酒糧，皆辭不受。
units.en: Grand Commandant Zhao Xi admired his integrity and sent seasonal gifts of wine and grain through his son; Gong courteously refused every time.
units.literal: Grand Commandant Zhao Xi admired his intent; every season he sent his son with gifts of wine and grain; all were declined and not accepted.

units.zh: 郡數以禮請，謝不肯應，母強遣之，恭不得已而西，因留新豐教授。
units.en: The commandery invited him repeatedly with due ceremony; he declined until his mother insisted; he finally traveled west and settled in Xinfeng as a teacher.
units.literal: The commandery repeatedly summoned him with ritual propriety; he declined and would not respond; his mother forced him to go; Gong had no choice but to go west and therefore stayed at Xinfeng to teach.

units.zh: 憙復舉恭直言，特詔公車，拜中牟令。
units.en: Zhao Xi next recommended him for forthright counsel; an edict routed him through the Waiting Coaches office and named him magistrate of Zhongmou.
units.literal: Xi again recommended Gong for blunt counsel; he was specially summoned by edict to the Waiting Coaches office and appointed magistrate of Zhongmou.

units.zh: 恭專以德化為理，不任刑罰，訟人許伯等爭田，累守令不能決，恭為平理曲直，皆退而自責，輟耕相讓。
units.en: Gong ruled by moral suasion rather than the lash. When Xu Bo and others sued over farmland—cases prior magistrates could not untangle—Gong weighed the rights of each party so fairly that both sides blamed themselves, left off farming, and ceded ground to each other.
units.literal: Gong devoted himself to governing through moral transformation and did not rely on punishments; litigants such as Xu Bo disputed fields; successive grand administrators and magistrates could not decide; Gong for them settled right and wrong; all withdrew and blamed themselves, stopped plowing and yielded to one another.

units.zh: 亭長從人借牛而不肯還之，牛主訟於恭。
units.en: A village pavilion chief borrowed an ox and would not give it back; the owner appealed to Gong.
units.literal: A pavilion chief borrowed someone's ox and refused to return it; the ox's owner appealed to Gong.

units.zh: 恭召亭長，敕令歸牛者再三，猶不從。
units.en: Gong called the chief in and repeatedly ordered him to return the ox, yet the man defied him.
